summary: The note covers the 1955 World Series, in which the Brooklyn Dodgers defeated the New York Yankees in seven games to win their first championship in franchise history. It was the only Series the Dodgers won while based in Brooklyn, since the team moved to Los Angeles after the 1957 season. The note also places the matchup in context as the fifth Dodgers-Yankees Series meeting in nine years.
one_line: The 1955 World Series, where the Brooklyn Dodgers beat the New York Yankees in seven games for their first title.

The New York Yankees won the World Series against the Dodgers in 1953.
